what_it_is.prose: Boeing delivered India's 12th P-8I in February 2022, completing the aircraft fleet documented in the cited Boeing release. The Indian Navy was Boeing's first international P-8 customer. The platform is used for maritime reconnaissance and surveillance and forms a major part of India's naval aviation architecture. This dossier treats the P-8I as a foreign-origin platform in Indian service and does not infer indigenous content from operational support or local supplier participation.
